propositions: The review-bot container has no AWS region configured, causing boto3 client construction to fail with NoRegionError before any model invocation occurs.
build_bedrock_provider does not validate that boto3 can resolve a region, allowing pydantic-ai's UserError to escape uncaught rather than raising a typed LLMConfigError naming the rebar setting.
AWS_REGION environment variable alone does not work on the pinned botocore; only AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is recognized by boto3.session.Session().region_name, per the configprovider mapping.
IMDS reachability is orthogonal to region discovery; IMDS can supply credentials but never a region, so instance-metadata fixes do not resolve the cutover failure.
The bedrock-access runbook and all prior Bedrock probes passed region_name explicitly, masking the missing-region defect from discovery until production cutover.
CloudWatch voter metrics in voter.py silently fail for the same reason: missing region in the container environment.
